tagline: Global property and casualty insurance leader with diversified underwriting strategy
hero_kpi_rationale: Key indicator of the size and financial capacity of the global insurance group, reflecting its leading position in the P&C sector with total assets of $272 billion

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.explanation: Total assets of the company reflecting its financial scale and investment capacity
kpis.description: Total assets of the company, indicator of its size and capacity to invest, verified from 10-K balance sheet
kpis.signal: Key indicator of company size and financial capacity

kpis.name: Shareholders Equity
kpis.explanation: Total shareholders equity excluding noncontrolling interests
kpis.description: Shareholders equity of the company excluding noncontrolling interests, indicator of financial solidity and capital base
kpis.signal: Key indicator of financial strength and solvency

kpis.short: Gross Unpaid Losses and Loss Expenses
kpis.name: Gross Unpaid Losses and Loss Expenses
kpis.explanation: Total gross unpaid losses and loss expenses reserves at year-end
kpis.description: Gross unpaid losses and loss expenses at December 31, 2025, reflecting claims incurred but not yet settled, increased from $84.004B at year-end 2024
kpis.signal: Core liability metric for insurance operations

kpis.short: Net Unpaid Losses and Loss Expenses
kpis.name: Net Unpaid Losses and Loss Expenses
kpis.explanation: Net unpaid losses and loss expenses after reinsurance recoverable
kpis.description: Net unpaid losses and loss expenses after reinsurance recoverable deduction, representing core claims obligations
kpis.signal: Key liability metric after reinsurance protection

kpis.name: Cigna Business Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Strategic acquisition of Cigna's accident and health and life insurance business in Asian markets in 2022
kpis.description: Acquisition of Cigna's personal accident and supplemental health (A&H) and life insurance business in several Asian markets in 2022, advancing product and geographic diversification strategy
kpis.signal: Strategic expansion into personal accident and supplemental health business

kpis.name: Huatai Insurance Controlling Interest
kpis.explanation: Acquisition of controlling majority interest in Huatai Insurance Group Co. Ltd, a Chinese financial services holding company
kpis.description: Achieved controlling majority interest in Huatai Group on July 1, 2023, with ownership interest at 87.2% as of December 31, 2025, advancing diversification with separate P&C, life, and asset management subsidiaries
kpis.signal: Strategic expansion into Chinese insurance market with property, casualty, life and asset management operations

risks.title: Natural and Man-Made Catastrophes
risks.score_rationale: Substantial exposure to losses from natural disasters, terrorism, cyber-attacks and catastrophic events. Climate change may increase frequency and severity of catastrophes. High intensity language and material impact potential on results of operations.

risks.title: Catastrophes
risks.score_rationale: Catastrophes can have a significant impact on the company's results, as mentioned in the 10-K, with high intensity of language and an increased risk context compared to the prior year.

risks.title: Cyber Risk and Technology Failures
risks.score_rationale: Increasing exposure to cyber risk and potential third-party infiltrations. Company operations depend on technology resources and information systems security to prevent material IT failures.

risks.title: Credit and Reinsurance Counterparty Risk
risks.score_rationale: Credit developments of reinsurers and ability to collect reinsurance recoverable. Changes in cost, quality or availability of reinsurance can impact business. Material differences in assessments for guaranty funds and pooling arrangements.

risks.title: Regulatory and Legislative Changes
risks.score_rationale: Uncertainties relating to governmental, legislative and regulatory policies and developments. Swiss corporation subject to specific regulatory burdens and reduced flexibility on capital management aspects.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: Competitive environment with trends in pricing and policy terms that may differ from projections. Changes in market conditions could render business strategies ineffective.

risks.title: Climate Change Impacts
risks.score_rationale: Climate change may increase frequency and severity of natural catastrophes and resulting losses. Impacts to risk modeling assumptions and potential legal and regulatory responses to climate concerns.

ai_positioning.summary: Chubb Limited does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related topics in its 10-K filing for the year ended December 31, 2025
